text: Ferrus Manus and Fulgrim were the closest of all the Emperor's sons.
To honour their bond, they forged weapons for each other.
Ferrus made Fireblade, a sword that burned forever. Fulgrim made Forgebreaker, a mighty hammer.
Then Fulgrim fell to the dark gods, and begged his brother to join Horus.
On Isstvan Five, they met again, each holding the other's gift.
Ferrus was winning. Then Fulgrim drew a daemon blade.
With one stroke, he cut off his best friend's head.
The Iron Hands never found their father's body.
And Fulgrim knew, too late, how far he had fallen.
